newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 147,200 MT improved from the previous week's slow pace and were nearly one-third above the 4-week average. Major increases for China (54,500 MT), Ecuador (24,000 MT), the Dominican Republic (13,500 MT), Saudi Arabia (13,000 MT), and Colombia (12,700 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (12,000 MT).

Exports of 174,100 MT--a marketing-year high--were 12 percent above the previous week and 46 percent more than the 4-week average. China (94,300 MT), the Dominican Republic (13,100 MT), Canada (12,300 MT), and Japan (12,100 MT) were the major destinations.
